name: tracker-session-health
goal: Prove ten-minute native Tracker health detection, verified prompt submission, conservative recovery and CoS visibility on both Macs.

evidence: Native tick runs idle/startup only and legacy recovery services are disconnected. Native tmux reports key delivery without verifying Codex submission. Prior Tracker incidents are ztgxwd, 1r5v1k, mymm0t, and wkk03d.

Extend the existing native runtime watchdog test to exercise the operation from its dry-run API and verify durable CoS visibility, plus the existing tmux pane-identity workload to verify key submission.
